label_source: Source text files in HuggingFace repository (filename-encoded classes)

label_provenance.conclusion: Every retained row maps to exactly one documented source label value; provenance is auditable; zero unmatched.

conflict_investigation.finding: Conflicting rows are a genuine source-annotation artifact: the same normalized text string appears in more than one class file (e.g. 'buy the dip' appears in both Neutral and Bearish files). They are NOT formatting/normalization artifacts and NOT LLM/sentiment assignments.
conflict_investigation.decision: Keep drop behavior. No deterministic source-grounded way to resolve without guessing.

duplicate_analysis.critical_finding: The HF training split contains 210,699 rows but only 91,168 unique texts. The dataset card documents the true training size as 91,758 observations (57,932 bullish + 26,516 neutral + 7,310 bearish). The extra ~119K training rows are duplicated texts, which is a data-construction artifact of the HF builder. Training on 210,699 rows with ~119K duplicates would overfit duplicates and double-count examples. Also, validation<->test exact overlap is 865 texts (7.2% of test), which weakens independence between model selection and evaluation.

class_weights_train_only.note: Weights computed from TRAINING distribution only. Validation/test not rebalanced.

colab_feasibility.note: Frozen BERT featurization is one-time and cached (~7 min on T4); head training is cheap. Full data is computationally feasible on one T4.

methodological_concerns: Training split contains ~119K duplicate rows (artificial inflation to 210,699 vs documented 91,758). MUST decide: deduplicate training to unique texts before training.
Validation<->test exact-text overlap of 865 texts (7.2% of test) weakens the independence of model selection from final evaluation.
Class imbalance toward Bullish; use train-only inverse-frequency class weights.
Conflicting-label rows (~1,162) dropped; keep drop behavior; reported not guessed.
